title: Fourth moment bound for the normalized sum
statement:
Let $n$ be a positive natural number, and choose $x$ uniformly from $\{-1,1\}^n$. The fourth moment of the normalized coordinate sum satisfies
\[\mathbb E\left[\left(\frac{1}{\sqrt n}\sum_{i=1}^n x_i\right)^4\right]\le 3.\]
